main_measure.name: t of the mean of forecast/10 x excess 18-bar return on grid bars with forecast > 0
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 (with supporting check), reject if t <= -2

supporting_check.name: top-half minus bottom-half excess 18-bar return, split at median forecast (Welch t)

decided_by: The main t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: Grid bars are positions 0, 18, 36, ... of each window with the 18-bar return inside the window; drift is the coin's mean 18-bar return on these grids over all windows; the median split puts forecasts above the median in the top half, the rest in the bottom half.
